is_anopheles.evidence: Wild-collected Anopheles larvae were collected and tested, including members of the Anopheles gambiae complex (An. arabiensis, An. gambiae s.s.), An. squamosus, An. rufipes, and An. coustani (Page 1, Abstract & Materials and Methods; Page 2, Figure 1B/C).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper performs PCR for species identification within the An. gambiae complex (reference 20, Wilkins et al. 2006), but does not genotype any target insecticide resistance markers (e.g., Vgsc 995F/S, Ace-1, GSTe2, Cyp6, etc.).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts/frequencies for insecticide-resistance target markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild Anopheles larvae/pupae were collected from aquatic habitats across four villages in Bungoma County, Kenya between June 2023 and February 2024 and reared to adults for bioassays (Page 1, Materials and Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original bioassay data and species composition of mosquito collections in Bungoma County, Kenya.

sub_country_location.evidence: Sampling took place across four villages in Bungoma County / Webuye, Kenya (Page 1, Materials and Methods; Page 3, header).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Larval collections were conducted between June 2023 and February 2024 (Page 1, Materials and Methods).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes fresh field collections carried out between June 2023 and February 2024 for this study.

supplement.evidence: No missing target marker data; the paper did not conduct resistance marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of PBO-LLINs (Olyset Plus) and WHO tube bioassays against wild-collected malaria vectors (An. gambiae s.l. and secondary vectors) across four villages in Bungoma County, Kenya in 2023-2024. While species identification PCR was performed on survived vs. succumbed mosquitoes, no target insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped, making the study ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers (reports_target_markers = false).
Does not report extractable genotype data for target resistance markers (reports_extractable_genotype_data = false).
